thread:
Rajesh: Quick sync — I ran a small bring-up of draft-ozma-7b quantized + speculative decoding on dev inputs. Throughput looks promising (~1.9x tokens/s vs baseline) but we've got a small quality hit on summarization tests.
Elaine: ran the same overnight on the 8-bit PTQ snapshot. Throughput 1.8x stable. ROUGE-L down ~0.6–0.9 points on newseval, and a couple of long-form Q&A examples lost context in the middle.
Sam: can you paste the exact launch command + config you used?
Elaine: sure — used dedicated-gpu pool, config below:
```
MODEL=draft-ozma-7b
QUANT=ptq8
DECODE=strategy:speculative,depth:2,prefetch_window:64
BATCHER=batch_size:8,max_tokens:2048
KV_WARMUP=true
```
Ran with 3 warmup tokens and default scheduler.
Rajesh: plan: we should run a small ablation matrix — depth {1,2,3} x prefetch {32,64,128} x kv_warmup {on,off}. Also test fallback behavior: if speculative candidate confidence < threshold then fall back to non-spec.
Maria: FYI I found ~2% of samples with the speculative config introduced a hallucinated sentence in multi-turn summarization. I posted the examples in the gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/ozma-spec-regen (quick review only).
ops-bot: nightly/spec-onboard job started for draft-ozma-7b (job id: spec-onboard-20260322-07). ETA ~2h.
Sam: for eval metrics let's use: ROUGE-L, BLEU for code snippets, perplexity delta on heldout, and a small human rating (200 random samples) focused on factuality/coherence. Also capture token-level latency (P50/P95) and percent of fallbacks triggered.
Rajesh: agree. Acceptance criteria suggestion: quality regression <= 0.5 ROUGE-L and hallucination rate delta < 0.5% absolute. If exceeded, block speculative rollout and enable auto-fallback.
Elaine: note — quantization knob matters: PTQ8 gave the best throughput but QAT-relaxed produced slightly better quality on the same latency budget. Will add QAT run to the matrix.
Maria: also add safety prompts from our hallucination suite; speculative sometimes amplifies confident-but-fake answers. If safety score worsens, we should consider lowering speculative depth or increasing candidate scoring strictness.
Sam: can someone add the experiment IDs to the shared dashboard? I want a chart: quality vs tokens/s with points for each config.
Rajesh: creating a PR to wire metrics -> console under /models/draft-ozma-7b/speculative. Assigning @Sam to triage human eval. I'll post run artifacts when ops-bot finishes.
Elaine: quick note for ops — please pin the dedicated pool so these runs don't hit autoscale flaps, last time we got noisy P95s.
ops-bot: confirmed: pool pinned for job spec-onboard-20260322-07 until 2026-03-22T12:30Z.
Maria: thanks — once we have the ablation results I'll curate a 50-sample diffset for a rapid human check (focus on multi-turn context drift).
Rajesh: perfect. If we see regressions we can try: 1) reduce speculative depth, 2) tighten reranker score threshold, 3) enable more aggressive KV-warmup. We'll reconvene after results. :thumbsup:
